title: Nothing stands outside Hukam
summary: All conditions unfold within Hukam, and ego shrinks when this is understood. Stop searching for a place outside Hukam.
takeaway: Stop searching for a place outside Hukam.
lifeApplication: When the mind says this should not be happening, feel both feet on the floor and answer it with the line. Let Hukam become larger than your protest.

source.shortMeaning: All conditions unfold within Hukam, and ego shrinks when this is understood.
source.lifeApplication: In resistance, remember there is no corner of this moment outside Hukam.
